entities.name: 分块 (chunking)

evidence.quote: And today, I want to talk to you about something that most people don't want to talk about, which is chunking.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I hope to convince you by the end that chunking isn't dead and there is something to do with that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And even when someone says, well, RAG isn't dead, like Jerry, the CEO of LlamaIndex, they still have to kill something, and apparently this something is chunking.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And this is the reason that people said that chunking is dead, because everybody's using agentic search now, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I think that the main reason that a lot of people don't like to talk about chunking is because it's not the fun part.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And you can, right, we talk a lot about the fixed chunking strategies where if your chunk is something which is too big, right, so you get the whole picture, which is nice, but you're losing a lot of the nuance and all the chunks will not get meaningful embeddings.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So what this tells us is that chunking is essentially a lossy compression.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Just from doing strategy on chunking, and very simple strategy, may I add.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 检索调优 (retrieval tuning)
entities.how_described: 本集说每次查询时调 top K、玩混合搜索的那套玩法;Yuval 主张如果要杀掉什么,该死的其实是它

entities.name: 多尺度索引 (multiscale indexing)
entities.how_described: AI21 本集提出的方法:把数据库复制 N 份、用不同块大小分别建索引,检索时全部并行查询,取出整个文档后用 RRF 融合排名,提升 20-40%

evidence.quote: And we call it the multiscale indexing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: RRF
entities.how_described: 本集用来把 N 个排名列表融合成一个的简单公式(Reciprocal Rank Fusion),试过的方法里效果最好,只是个几乎不花时间的简单脚本,不是模型

evidence.quote: That's why we are using something called RRF, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, which is pretty much a simple formula.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we have the indexing n times, then we query each query from every database, and we are using RRF to combine them all.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: However, if you think about it, latency-wise, it doesn't really affect that because you can do all the retrieval part parallelly and also the RRF part doesn't really take a lot of time.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Also go beyond RRF.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The fact that we're using RRF is because it worked the best from the methods that we used, but it doesn't mean that there is no better method.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
